Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		foundCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		foundCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.InputCard = foundCard and
		self.CardIDValidated = true and
		result = self.CardIDValidated or
		foundCard.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		self.InputCard = null and
		self.CardIDValidated = false and
		result = self.CardIDValidated
}
